name: Memory Cleaner
description: Periodically forces full GC + LOH compaction + working-set trim to mitigate Emby long-running memory bloat. 周期性触发完整 GC + LOH 压缩 + 工作集释放，缓解 Emby 长时间运行导致的内存膨胀。
overview: Lightweight standalone plugin (~460KB). Compatible with StrmAssistant. Configurable interval (1-120 min, default 30). Status panel shows current memory + last cleanup stats.

versions.changelog: Default interval changed to 30 minutes. Added runtime status panel (current memory + last cleanup stats).
